clock: perf_counter_ns, wall clock; stage instrumentation is excluded from the separately measured total and throughput
memory_scope: Per-case tracemalloc peaks track Python allocations and NumPy allocations exposed to tracemalloc; they exclude the preallocated inputs/steering and untraced native BLAS allocations. The separate OS process lifetime peak includes all benchmark cases, preallocated data and output assembly; it cannot be attributed to individual stages.
timing_scope: Fixed synthetic inputs and steering are prepared before each frame timing. Calibration is timed separately on a fixed noise block. Total includes allocation of per-frame outputs. Throughput is sequential processing, excludes calibration, has no I/O, and is not FPGA or real-time throughput.
comparison_scope: The exact-eigensolver AMD 5% proxy maps an all-eight count to zero. This program does not reproduce the finite-sweep AMD SVD or its hardware peak scanner. Dense and projected scans are checked against SVD/triangular solves and scalar dot products. MDL and mdl_scalar use the same criterion over orders 0 through 3; the latter uses scalar arithmetic and caches its fixed penalty.
